comments.text: Images of countries which DO respect all forms of life are as attractive as a beautiful heart, mind and soul. Fellow vegetarians, glad to have landed in the Northern Hemisphere with my pet dog❤

replies.author: @truehorizons66
replies.text: Thank you for sharing your thoughts! Norway’s natural beauty is truly remarkable, and we’re glad the documentary resonated with you. Wishing you and your four-legged companion many wonderful adventures! 🇳🇴🐾
